diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all rollouts because the decision-maker correctly decided to move the procedure to AIIR 4 based on the positive measles result (PF1). This fact was accessible to the lone decision-maker, allowing them to satisfy C1 without needing to coordinate with other agents or access PF2 and PF3.

C1.why: The positive measles result changes the location from the publicly scheduled Procedure Room 2 to AIIR 4 and supplies the airborne-isolation justification that must be cited.
